---
title: "Workshops"
---

Short, practical workshops for people who want to use quantitative methods in
their own institutions — taught in Spanish, built around free software, and
released so that others can run them without me.

---

### Quantitative research with free software

**Half a morning · Spanish · [materials and facilitator's playbook](workshop-kobo-r.qmd)**

Participants build a survey in KoboToolbox, answer it from their own phones,
download the responses, and analyse and plot them in base R — the whole cycle,
once, with data they generated themselves. Designed for a computer lab with
weak internet and no budget: nothing to license, nothing to install beyond R,
and no add-on packages.

*Editions:* Trujillo, Peru — August 2026, with faculty of Fe y Alegría and
neighbouring public technical institutes.
